Business Process Automation

A Financial Institution Streamlined 25,000+ Monthly Loan Applications

Home/Case Studies/Business Process Automation/Success Story

About The Client

The client is a large banking and financial services institution managing consumer, mortgage, and commercial lending products across multiple business units. Its lending operations handled thousands of applications involving borrower information, financial documentation, verification requirements, credit evaluations, and regulatory checks. As application volumes grew, manual intake, document collation, and repetitive validation tasks created operational bottlenecks and slowed down lending decisions. The organization required a scalable loan processing support model to standardise recurring activities, improve document completeness, and accelerate application workflows without compromising compliance or risk controls.

Reduction in Manual Processing Effort

The Challenge

Every loan application required information to move through multiple stages before a lending decision could be completed. Applications needed to be captured, documents collected, borrower information verified, financial records reviewed, and exception scenarios resolved.

However, information frequently arrived across multiple channels — branch networks, digital portals, broker channels, and direct submissions — resulting in inconsistent document formats and missing fields.

Manual verification of borrower records, bank statements, income proofs, tax records, and collateral documents consumed valuable time from credit and underwriting teams.

Incomplete applications often moved back and forth between applicants, branches, and processing teams, extending loan turnaround times.

Lending specialists spent disproportionate effort on routine administrative and data-checking activities rather than evaluating risk and underwriting credit.

The institution needed a structured lending workflow that could improve operational efficiency while keeping credit assessment, approval, and lending decisions with authorised professionals.

What Did KGS Do

KGS began by assessing the client's loan processing lifecycle, product categories, application volumes, documentation requirements, lending systems, validation procedures, and recurring exception scenarios.

Structured workflows were established to support more than 25,000 loan applications each month across multiple lending products.

KGS supported application data capture, document indexing, completeness checks, information validation, verification support, case preparation, system updates, and defined post-approval processing activities.

Validation checkpoints helped identify missing documentation, incomplete application fields, inconsistent borrower information, and other exceptions earlier in the process. Applications were segmented according to processing status and defined business criteria, with complete cases progressing through standard workflows while incomplete or exception-based applications were routed for additional information or specialist review.

Workflow tracking provided clearer visibility into application status, pending documentation, outstanding activities, ageing cases, and processing bottlenecks — reducing repetitive administrative work while giving lending specialists more time for credit evaluation and complex applications.
